Latest Activity.note: A trade press article from 26 January 2026 says the Swiss company BKW wants a 40 percent stake in the planned third block at Hamm. Trianel says it will probably take part in the capacity tenders if the conditions give municipal companies a fair chance. It says an investment decision still needs the final rules.

Status Detail.value: Planned third block with about 500 MW. In January 2026 Trianel said an investment decision still depends on the final tender rules. A Swiss investor, BKW, seeks a 40 percent stake. No permit application and no award found.
Status Detail.note: Both articles say the investment decision waits on federal rules. The older local radio report from August 2025 says the same. I found no permit application and no tender award for this block.

units.notes: The third block is still only planned. I found no permit application, no turbine order and no tender award. No source gives a new start date, so the start year is left alone.

qa.recommendation: The start year of 2026 is no longer realistic and the unit may fit announced better than pre-construction.
qa.note: As of January 2026 Trianel still waited for final tender rules before an investment decision. I found no permit application, no turbine order and no award. The life cycle rules ask for active permit or financing steps for pre-construction. The partner search with BKW is a financing step, so I left the status as it is.

qa.recommendation: Watch for a closed deal with BKW.
qa.note: BKW seeks a 40 percent stake. This is not a closed deal, so the owner is not changed. The project is also described as a joint project with the municipal utility of Hamm.
